name: Polyoxyethylene (10) isooctylcyclohexyl ether
description: Polyoxyethylene (10) isooctylcyclohexyl ether (CAS 92046-34-9 ) is a nonionic ethoxylated surfactant built on a saturated cyclohexyl backbone. This structure distinguishes it from conventional octyl phenol ethoxylate alternatives. It functions as an emulsifier, wetting agent, and dispersant across a range of industrial and personal care formulations. In water treatment, it improves the dispersion of scale inhibitors and biocides. This helps active ingredients reach target surfaces more effectively. Textile and leather processors use it as a wetting and scouring agent to ensure uniform dye penetration and consistent surface preparation. Formulators in cleaning and degreasing compounds rely on it to emulsify oils and soils in both aqueous and semi-aqueous systems. It provides reliable performance across various fiber types and substrates. In printing and packaging, it supports ink dispersion and substrate wetting, contributing to print uniformity and adhesion quality. This versatility makes it a staple in high-performance chemical manufacturing. Polyoxyethylene (10) isooctylcyclohexyl ether is typically supplied as a liquid or viscous paste. It is available in technical grade, with supply specifications commonly aligned to industrial surfactant standards. These standards include specific HLB values, ethylene oxide content, and active matter content.
